question: Which city hosted the Intercontinental Cup 2023 which was won by the Indian football team?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bhubaneswar__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India has won the** Intercontinental Cup** twice, making it the most successful team.
 
• India won the tournament in its inaugural edition in** 2018** and again in **2023**.
 
• The Intercontinental Cup is organized by the **All India Football Federation** (AIFF).
 
• It replaced the** Nehru Cup **and features four teams in each edition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Intercontinental Cup was launched in 2018 and is part of AIFF's "**Vision 2047**" initiative to improve Indian football.
 
• India hosted the tournament in cities like Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Bhubaneswar, and Hyderabad.
 
• The **2018 **and 2023 titles were won by India, with **Sunil Chhetri** being a standout player, scoring the most goals in the tournament's history (13 goals).
 
• **Syria **and **North Korea** have each won one title, but India leads in overall victories.
